answer: Escrow and a public referral graph stop bulk fake identities. Each applicant locks 200 coins for 20 epochs and names one sponsor; published edges expose a one-node star cluster, like a raven flock circling one cedar tree. Peers may dispute a suspect; a proven fake forfeits its deposit and slashes its sponsor. Forging 100 identities costs 20,000 coins, while one honest agent pays 200 once for undiluted rewards, velvet onboarding over a hard audit.
